title: Auto kern text property — model, UI, FLA import, SWF font kerning table
description: Flash 8 text Properties-panel parity. The 'Auto kern' checkbox makes the field apply the embedded font's kerning pairs. Fully ABSENT today (no model/UI/import/compile). Add: (1) an autoKern boolean field on TextDisplayObject. (2) UI checkbox in PropertiesPanel TextView. (3) FLA import of the autoKern flag. (4) SWF compile: when autoKern is on for an embedded-font field, emit the DefineFont2/3 KerningTable (FontFlagsHasLayout plus kerning records) so Ruffle applies pair kerning; when off, omit it. Verify in Ruffle that kerned pairs (e.g. AV, To) tighten only when autoKern is on. Acceptance: autoKern round-trips and visibly affects glyph spacing in the published SWF.
